cases.description: Inbound lead with budget, authority, timeline: evidence gates true and route = sales

request.state:
INBOUND LEAD FORM
Name: Dana Whitfield, VP Engineering at Helio Logistics (1,800 employees)
Message: We are replacing our current vendor before the contract ends on Nov 30. Budget of $250k for this fiscal year is approved by our CFO and I sign off on tooling purchases. We need SSO and audit logs. Can we get a demo this week?

has_budget.instructions: Does the lead state that a concrete budget is available?

criteria.true: a budget amount or approved funding is stated
criteria.false: no budget is mentioned or budget is explicitly absent

has_authority.instructions: Does the lead say they personally can approve or sign the purchase?

criteria.true: the lead is a decision maker or signs off on purchases
criteria.false: the lead is not a decision maker or authority is unstated

route.instructions: Where should this inbound lead be routed?

criteria.sales: a qualified buyer with budget, authority and timeline; send to a sales rep now
criteria.nurture: interested but not ready to buy; add to a marketing nurture sequence
criteria.support: an existing customer with a support problem
criteria.discard: spam, a job seeker, or an irrelevant message

cases.description: Live document rescoring: 4 dimensions of a design-doc draft in one request; good draft with weak testing section

request.state:
DRAFT DESIGN DOC
Title: Rate limiter for public API
Problem: Bursty clients cause p99 latency spikes on the orders API (measured 2.4s at peak on Sept 3).
Proposal: Token bucket per API key in Redis, 100 req/s sustained, burst 200. Return 429 with Retry-After. Fallback to local in-memory limiter if Redis is down (fail open, alert on-call).
Alternatives considered: sliding window log (rejected: memory heavy), gateway-level limiting (rejected: no per-key data).
Testing: TBD.
Rollout: TBD.

clarity.instructions: Rate how clearly the problem and proposal are stated.

alternatives.instructions: Rate how well alternatives and tradeoffs are covered.
criteria: several alternatives with explicit rejection reasons

testing_plan.instructions: Rate how complete the testing plan section is.
criteria: detailed plan with unit, load and failure-injection tests
